card.name: Inside EMBRYO-FETAL warning headings
card.fires_on: The letter O in EMBRY-O in the all-caps boxed warning heading EMBRYO-FETAL TOXICITY. It also fires weakly on the last letter of a drug name in a warnings heading, and on spaces or bars between list fields.

modes.label: Boxed warning heading
modes.description: The O that finishes EMBRY before the hyphen in the capitalized embryo-fetal toxicity warning.

modes.label: Drug name in warnings
modes.description: The last letter of a split capitalized drug name at the start of a warnings section.
modes.example: WARNINGS ETHAMOLl<<N>> Injection should be used in pregnant women only

modes.label: Web list separators
modes.description: A space or bar between fields in web page listings.

card.plain: It marks the middle of the capitalized EMBRYO-FETAL TOXICITY warning heading, and shows up weakly in a few other headings.
